content_zh:
临水郡，清风城。
牧府议事厅中。
诸多在牧族中有威望的长者、族老，以及实力强大的中年男子，都围坐在一块儿。
厅下，则是笔直站立着一名身着青衫的少年。
此时，大厅气氛显得极为低沉。
这，像极了一场审判。
坐在最上方首座的中年男子，是牧族的当代族长，牧海雄。
片刻之后，牧海雄打破宁静，沉吟道：“牧帆，你至尊武脉被毁之后，修为也废了，此生无法再修武道，沦为废人，经过多日商议，本族长和诸多长老决定，即今日起，废除你少族长的身份，你，可有异议？”
一瞬间，大厅内所有人的目光，都投向笔直站立着的少年身上。
少年，正是牧海雄口中的牧帆，他面无表情的点头，“没有异议。”
听到这话，牧海雄继续冰冷的说道：“你已成废人，将临水学院的特招令也交出来吧！”
废人！
听起来很是刺耳。
“这一天，还是来了……”
牧帆面庞丝毫不起波澜，像是早有预料一般。
少年牧帆，天生拥有至尊武脉，展现出惊人的武道天赋，堪称武道奇才，早早就被立为牧族的少族长，族中长者都寄予厚望。
无数荣誉和光环加身，甚至是传出了偌大的临水郡！
临水郡唯一的一座武道学院——临水学院，直接送来特招令，让牧帆加入临水学院，不需要像其他弟子一样，还得通过重重考核！
须知，自从大夏帝国建立以来，为了防止各个宗门做大，导致皇权下降，因此在大夏皇室最为强盛的时候，直接将大夏境内的所有武道宗门都清理干净，然后每一郡建立一座属于皇室的武道学院，专门指导修行。
临水学院，可以说是集一郡，所有修炼天赋过人的年轻小辈了，所以考核难度非常高。

很多小辈，挤破头也进不了临水学院，可想而知，牧帆的特招令有多特殊了！
然而，一年前，牧帆遭人暗算，至尊武脉被毁，修为也废了，彻底沦为废人，从神坛跌落谷底！
天下修武者，必先要觉醒出沟通天地灵气的武脉。
没有觉醒出武脉，或者武脉被废，将不能再修武道，所以武脉的重要性不言而喻。
武脉，品质不一，分一到九等。
一等武脉最次，九等武脉品质最好，修炼速度会快上很多，并且日后成就也往往更高。
牧帆的至尊武脉，不在一到九等行列，却是更加珍贵！
一年的时间，刚开始时牧族的人到处请医师，试图帮助牧帆修复武脉，可惜没有用。
武脉被废，或者没有觉醒武脉，将无缘武道之路，这几乎是常识。
到后来，族中长者也都不再抱任何希望，就终于有了眼前的一幕。
牧海雄见牧帆没有动，便是讥讽道：“怎么，你不愿意？你一个废人，就算有特招令，人家临水学院还会要你？”
“是啊，人家学院可不收废人！”
“还真以为自己还是那个天才呢！”
其他好几位长者都是毫不客气的开口。
牧帆嘴角露出一抹嘲弄，他并非不愿意交出特招令，只是这些人的态度，令人心寒。
他牧帆，为牧族争来过很多修炼资源。
清风城虽然很小，但再小的地方总会有势力划分，牧族为三大家族之一。
content_en:
Linshui County, Qingfeng City.
In the council hall of the Mufu.
Many prestigious elders, clan elders, and powerful middle-aged men in the herdsmen were all sitting together.
Under the hall, a young man in a green shirt stood upright.
At this time, the atmosphere in the hall seemed extremely gloomy.
This is like a trial.
The middle-aged man sitting in the top seat is Mu Haixiong, the contemporary patriarch of the Mu tribe.
After a moment, Mu Haixiong broke the silence and muttered: "Mu Fan, after your supreme martial arts was destroyed, your cultivation was also ruined. You will no longer be able to practice martial arts in this life, and you have become a useless person. After many days of deliberation, this clan leader and many elders have decided to abolish your status as the young clan leader starting today. Do you have any objections?"
In an instant, everyone in the hall turned their attention to the young man standing upright.
The young man was the Mu Fan whom Mu Haixiong mentioned. He nodded expressionlessly, "No objection."
After hearing this, Mu Haixiong continued to say coldly: "You have become a useless person, please hand over the special recruitment order from Linshui College!"
Useless person!
It sounds very harsh.
"This day has come..."
Mu Fan's face remained calm at all, as if he had expected it.
The young Mu Fan was born with supreme martial arts and showed amazing talent in martial arts. He can be called a martial arts wizard. He was appointed as the young leader of the Mu clan early on, and the elders of the clan had high hopes for him.
Countless honors and auras have been added to it, and it has even spread to the huge Linshui County!
Linshui Academy, the only martial arts academy in Linshui County, directly sent a special recruitment order for Mu Fan to join Linshui Academy. He did not need to pass the numerous examinations like other disciples!
It should be noted that since the founding of the Daxia Empire, in order to prevent the various sects from getting bigger and causing the imperial power to decline, when the Daxia royal family was at its strongest, all the martial arts sects in Daxia were directly cleaned up, and then a martial arts academy belonging to the royal family was established in each county to specifically guide practice.
Linshui Academy can be said to have gathered all the young juniors with outstanding cultivation talents in one county, so the examination is very difficult.
Many juniors couldn't get into Linshui College even if they squeezed their heads. You can imagine how special Mu Fan's special recruitment order is!
However, a year ago, Mu Fan was plotted by someone, his supreme martial arts was destroyed, his cultivation was ruined, he was completely reduced to a useless person, and he fell from the altar to the bottom!
Martial arts cultivators in the world must first awaken the martial veins that connect the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
If one has not awakened his martial veins, or if his martial veins have been abolished, he will no longer be able to practice martial arts, so the importance of martial arts veins is self-evident.
Martial veins have different qualities and are divided into grades one to nine.
First-class martial arts are the lowest, and ninth-class martial arts are of the best quality. Their cultivation speed will be much faster, and their achievements in the future will often be higher.
Mu Fan's supreme martial art is not ranked among the first to ninth levels, but it is even more precious!
For a year, at the beginning, the Mu Fan people asked doctors everywhere to try to help Mu Fan repair his martial arts veins, but it was to no avail.
It is almost common sense that if the martial arteries are abolished or the martial arteries are not awakened, one will miss the path of martial arts.
Later, the elders in the clan no longer had any hope, and finally saw the scene in front of them.
When Mu Haixiong saw that Mu Fan didn't move, he sarcastically said, "What, you don't want to? You are a loser. Even if there is a special recruitment order, Linshui College will still want you?"
"Yeah, the academy doesn't accept useless people!"
"I really thought I was still that genius!"
Several other elders spoke unceremoniously.
There was a hint of ridicule on Mu Fan's lips. It was not that he was unwilling to hand over the special command, but the attitude of these people was chilling.
He, Mu Fan, had won a lot of training resources for the herdsmen.
Although Qingfeng City is small, no matter how small it is, there will always be divisions of power. The Mu clan is one of the three major families.
